summary_1line: Rama holds court in an ideal kingdom with no petitioners until Lakshmana discovers a howling dog at the palace gate.

image_candidates.scene_text: At dawn Rama sits on the royal throne in a hall of sages and ministers resembling the courts of the gods.
Lakshmana stands at the city gate calling for petitioners but finds the streets empty under Rama’s just rule.
A lone dog sits at the palace gate staring at Lakshmana and howling continuously.
